units.source_text: 在这个空荡荡、静悄悄的老房子里，我解开行李，开始读书了。

en.t: In this empty, quiet old house, I unpacked my luggage and began to read.

units.source_text: 不知怎么回事，我的心里很不踏实。

en.t: For some reason, I felt very unsettled inside.

units.source_text: 还不如在那令人眼花缭乱的东京居所的二楼上，听着远处电车驶过的噪音，一页一页地看书，

en.t: It was easier to sit on the second floor of that dazzling Tokyo lodging, listening to the noise of streetcars passing in the distance and reading page after page,

units.source_text: 更能够集中精神、心情愉快地学习呢。

en.t: and study with greater concentration and a more cheerful mind.

units.source_text: 看不了几页书，我便会靠着桌子打起瞌睡来，

en.t: After only a few pages, I would lean against the desk and start dozing,

units.source_text: 有时索性拿出枕头舒舒服服地睡个午觉。

en.t: and sometimes I would even take out a pillow and settle in comfortably for an afternoon nap.

units.source_text: 每次醒来，都会听到声声蝉鸣，

en.t: Whenever I woke up, I would hear the cries of the cicadas,

units.source_text: 只觉那半梦半醒之间一直在聒噪的蝉声，突然间搅扰了我的耳膜。

en.t: and the cicadas that had kept rasping through my half-dreaming state would suddenly seem to disturb my eardrums.

units.source_text: 有时凝神倾听，心中竟会涌起一股悲戚。

en.t: Sometimes, when I listened intently, a wave of sorrow would unexpectedly rise in my heart.
